examName: Veterinary Officer, Maharashtra Veterinary Services, Group-A, Main Examination - Question Paper Structure
examNameMr: पशुवैद्यक अधिकारी, महाराष्ट्र पशुवैद्यक सेवा, गट-अ, मुख्य परीक्षा - प्रश्नपत्रिका रचना

topics: Attempt any FOUR questions from Question No. 1 to 5.
Attempt either Question No. 6 or Question No. 7.
Attempt all questions from Question No. 8, 9 and 10.
The number of marks carried by a question/ sub question is indicated against it.
Keep in mind the word limit indicated in the question if any.
Wherever option has been given, only the required number of responses in the serial order attempted shall be assessed.
Candidates are expected to answer all the sub-questions of a question together.
Any page or portion of the page left blank in the Answer Booklet must be clearly struck off.
Unless otherwise mentioned, symbol and notation have their usual standard meanings. Assume suitable data, if necessary.
Neat sketches may be drawn, wherever required.
The medium of answer should be mentioned on the answer-book as claimed in the application.
Question No.1: Biostatistics and Computer Application, Blood, Cardiovascular, Nervous and Muscular Systems, Principles of Animal Nutrition and Feed Technology
Question No.2: Wildlife Nutrition, Ruminant Nutrition
Question No.3: Digestive and Respiratory Systems, Animal Welfare
Question No.4: Milk and Milk Products Technology, Excretory and Endocrine Systems
Question No.5: Abattoir Practices and Animal Byproducts Technology, Laboratory or Rabbit or Pet Animal Production Management
Question No.6: Animal Breeding and Management
Question No.7: Livestock Economics and Marketing, Methods of conservation
Question No.8: Principles of Animal and Population Genetics, Reproduction, Lactation, Growth and Environmental Physiology
Question No.9: Non-Ruminant Nutrition, General Livestock Management
Question No.10: Fodder Production and Conservation, Zoo Animals Production Management

importantNotes: Word Limit for Short Q (5 marks)-100 words, Short Q (10 marks)-150 words
Long Q (15 Marks)- 200 words, Long Q (20 Marks)- 250 words
